name: learnings-cluster
description: Request and response contract for the learnings clusterer. validate_clusters.py loads this file and enforces it at runtime, so the structure below is the single source of truth. Cross-field rules are named under rules; validate_clusters.py must implement exactly those names (a test fails on any mismatch).

learnings.description: Eligible learning rows for one target. Only id and improves are read here; the rest of the row is the learning contract's concern and passes through.

pregroups.description: Deterministic hints. Lists of learning ids.

errors.description: Present only on a retry. Reasons the previous response was rejected.

contradiction.description: Optional. true when learnings in or across clusters of this target ask for opposing changes to the same section. Carried through to cluster_flags.py.

rules.unique-request-ids: Learning ids in the request are unique.
rules.pregroup-ids-known: Every id in request.pregroups is a request learning id.
rules.unique-cluster-ids: Cluster ids in the response are unique.
rules.ids-known: Every cluster.learning_ids entry is a request learning id.
rules.partition: Every request learning id appears in exactly one cluster, once.
rules.no-escape-point: No escape_point key appears anywhere in the response. Escape points come from attribution records only.

clusters.root_cause: Runner artifacts are not verified at receipt collection.
clusters.fix: Check log_path exists before writing it back.
